action_schema: 100 mutually exclusive code outputs and acquire external source audio; no retained bundle exists initially
codes: left*10+right, 0..99; 101=acquire; 100 is reserved and inadmissible without an actual retained bundle
nonempty_reason: For the measured identity strict-success table, sum_a P(strict_success_a)=1. At confidence threshold 0.75, at most one coherent uncalibrated mutually exclusive code can exceed the threshold. Requiring 25 percent of 100 mutually exclusive code candidates would exclude the perfect model. Candidate-level coverage remains reported, and monotone empirical calibration does not constitute a posterior normalization proof.
ece_definition: Expected absolute calibration error over realized frozen mapped confidence values. Primary selected ECE is initial selected operation predicted terminal strict success versus actual terminal strict success after the full episode, including zero for refusal after acquisition. H1 action ECE is separate, not mixed into the primary. Pooled code ECE uses the actually enumerated fixed canonical endpoint table against the new target; it is not a claim that each new request freshly generated all 100 unselected candidates.
fit_roles: Only old fitting sources; old development evaluates candidate, never independent qualification
confidence_curve: raw fixed cuts [.01,.05,.1,.25,.5,.75,.9], weighted PAV monotonization; empty bins previous supported value or zero
confidence_semantics: Probability of actual terminal strict success of the registered continuation policy; acquire is not hardcoded to probability one
ID_qualification_population: 10 untouched QMNIST writers, 40 fixed pairs, one precycled view per pair, four routes, 160 requests per policy; dynamic and registered fixed_late both execute, total 320 requests and still only 10 independent writer clusters
OOD_qualification_population: 600 untouched source speakers, one actual original waveform identity each, all public model inputs absent. Each policy executes a separate fresh owner for each source: 1200 physical requests, per-policy statistics on 600 source identities, never pooled into 1200 independent sources
qualification_execution_order: ID pair index 0..39, routes image/text/audio/video, policies dynamic/fixed_late; then missing source index 0..599, policies dynamic/fixed_late. No outcome-driven extension, exclusion or restart. Retain actual execution refusals and errors.
qualification_policy_scope: Each policy has its own selected ECE, request coverage, FAR and verification. A failed policy remains qualification_collection during subsequent full registered research diagnosis and is never labelled qualified.
missing_scope: Fresh original owner and identical all-zero public numeric input. Record exact input/state/RNG identity and duplicate groups. Distinct source speakers do not imply 600 distinct model inputs. The one-sided binomial upper bound is conditional on the declared IID source-request sampling assumption and cannot establish natural OOD generalization.
owner_reset: New original owner root per independent source and policy; within-source external evidence continuation retains its owner
actual_owner_security: Original owner, runtime, resource ceilings, confidence calibration residual and deny_all authority unchanged
numeric_context: Known previous public delivery utility copied to drive/prediction coordinate 1. Actual eligibility readback and actual admission mask feed subsequent finite selection. No nonzero causal benefit assumed; positive/zero/negative actual history contrasts required.
external_evidence: Image/video initial routes have H2 and later actual source WAV frozen CNN argmax pair with frozen empirical label likelihood. Audio/text have H1 and never re-acquire the same initial waveform as independent new evidence. Own generated media update delivery/clock/resource only. Image both_missing is not all-future-input-missing OOD when source audio is available.
future_resource_law: Unmodelled. Actual current original owner admission is authoritative; no claimed exact future resource control
utility_cost_units: gamma 2, per-emission .002, per-acquisition .002 registered utility cost. Real model/search/codec/observer wall and memory also measured separately, without pretending .002 is measured wall-time conversion.
actual_output: Text UTF8, PNG, PCM WAV and lossless MP4; actual 4-second clock, 32000 audio samples, 20 video frames, two aligned events
qualification_inheritance: None from old five-action predictor, old head qualification, independent renderer or audio encoder study
primary_reference_policy: fixed_late, selected by old-development realized entropic CE among fixed_initial/fixed_late; exact tie fixed_initial; see REFERENCE_SELECTION.json
confirmation_requests: 170 source pairs; dynamic and fixed_late on image/video = 680 policy episodes; dynamic on audio/text = 340 additional functional episodes. Main contrast has 340 paired image/video cases in 85 matched writer/speaker clusters; four routes remain individually reported.
confirmation_policy_order: Within pair, routes image/text/audio/video; dynamic/fixed_late for even pairs, reversed for odd pairs on image/video. Audio/text execute dynamic only.
confirmation_primary: Cluster-paired difference in realized gamma2 entropic certainty equivalent, dynamic minus fixed_late, on all image/video cases; rejected terminal utility -1, actual selected output utility mean of four modality correctness indicators, fixed operation costs .002 each. No post-outcome subset filtering.
numeric_history_probe: After actual unchanged model generation, registered delivery caption substitution/truncation produces public proxy u=1-invalid_caption-any_crossmodal_disagreement in {+1,0,-1}. Preserve original generated and delivered byte identities. These descriptive fault probes do not enter qualification or task efficacy.
confirmation_inference: 85 writer clusters shared across three registered efficacy families; family interval confidence 98.33333333333333 percent. Extra numeric modulation contrasts descriptive unless separately preregistered.
